title: Evidence Graph Normalizer V1
goal: Make one uniform graph layer for assets, identities, findings, tasks, credential references, SaaS connectors, APIs, permissions, and evidence references.
scope: Defensive evidence normalization across existing run, task, finding, context, vault, and attack-path data.
generation_reason: AegisPT needs one normalized evidence graph model before higher-level hypothesis confidence, next-evidence planning, SaaS trust-chain modeling, and evidence gap reporting can be reliable.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Implement a defensive evidence-normalization layer. Do not execute tools, perform exploitation, expand scope, or access live targets.

success_criteria: Converts existing run, task, finding, context, vault, and attack-path data into normalized nodes and edges.
API returns graph with confidence and evidence references.
Tests prove no runtime dispatch or proposal approval occurs.

acceptance_criteria: Normalized graph response includes assets, identities, findings, tasks, credential refs, APIs, permissions, SaaS connectors, and evidence refs where source data exists.
Every edge includes provenance and confidence metadata.
No runtime tasks are dispatched and no proposals are approved by graph normalization.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next task into NEXT_TASK.md.
